SRC-215:R001.text: Investigate the stated systemic-availability hypotheses without presuming defect; distinguish correct, avoidable, recoverable and incorrect refusals using current authoritative source and evidence.

SRC-215:R002.text: Audit SAI_WEBSITE T-31 and reported E-336 through E-354 against the actual runtime contract; preserve the distinction between consumer observations and proven upstream root cause, with unavailable original evidence explicitly unresolved.

SRC-215:R003.text: Corroborate incident families A-E from original evidence: bounded continuation, ownership contention, runtime/skill mismatch, recovery/evidence reachability and global versus scoped stopping; otherwise mark them unproven.

SRC-215:R004.text: Deliver all twelve blocker taxonomy classes. For each state the operation that stops, independent allowed operations, permitted recovery, retained evidence, genuine human requirement, automatic retry conditions and authority or duplicate-effect risk.

SRC-215:R005.text: Evaluate NORMAL, DEGRADED, QUARANTINED and HARD_STOP; verify ticket-level isolation, safe engineering without lifecycle admission and possible narrower locks while preserving provenance, concurrency, authorization and integrity.

SRC-215:R006.text: Audit goal, cc, cc all, converge and bounded/runtime/session/ticket budgets; distinguish scope, ownership, lifecycle and external effects; propose checkpointed continuation, cancellation and resource limits that cannot override explicit user limits or revoked authority.

SRC-215:R007.text: Audit protocol, installed skills, CLI, runtime, schema, evidence services and consumer compatibility; document capability discovery, a versioned contract and honest outdated-skill degradation; preserve cryptographic/canonical byte integrity while evaluating semantic compatibility.

SRC-215:R008.text: Evaluate evidence order, ownership, provenance, stale selection, active admission, replay, crash, partial writes and migration; propose non-authoritative pending observations whose promotion needs full supported admission and never fabricates history.

SRC-215:R009.text: Map existing tests and missing coverage to the ten stated invariants; propose state-machine/property, fault/crash/concurrency, cross-version, idempotency, metamorphic, consumer and negative-control tests; disclose bounded coverage and never claim all states verified.

SRC-215:R010.text: Define all seven requested resilience metrics with source of truth, collection, denominator, false-positive and gaming risks, and reporting interval; do not invent baselines, percentages or trade correctness for availability.
